text:
Alex: Heads-up — planning a rolling reboot for az24 GPU pool (saturn-pool-3) on Tue 2026-03-30 02:00-04:00 UTC. We'll do cohorted node drains, 10-min spacing, KV-cache seed before handoff. Affects hosted inference and some Dedicated fallback lanes.
Priya: ETA on throughput impact? any expected P99 increases?
Alex: Expect short P99 blips during handoff, overall throughput target unchanged. We'll throttle batch windows to 4s while draining.
Mateo: Can we pin model routing to smaller variants during the window? want to avoid cross-region hops.
Lina: KV seed plan: run prefix-cache warmup on canaries + edge backfill. I can push the seed job at -30m.
Dan: Cost note — if we force-region-fallback to us-west, we may incur ~22% extra token cost on peak. ops: confirm.
ops-bot: scheduled maintenance created: ID mnt-az24-20260330. Notifying oncall and customers with >100 qps tenants.
Priya: What about Dedicated tenants — do we trigger failover or keep reserved pinned?
Alex: Dedicated: keep pinned, but we'll schedule rack-scoped soft-evac so reserved capacity stays. Only preemptible/spot pools get pre-drained.
Mateo: quick check — how are we handling GPU driver version? are we rolling driver or NVLINK fw too?
Alex: Driver roll only on subset (drivers v525 -> v528). NVLINK unchanged. We'll verify with a canary group of 3 nodes.
Lina: Command I'll run to cordon & drain (short):
```
kubectl cordon node/saturn-az24-node-07
kubectl drain node/saturn-az24-node-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=600
```
Mateo: add a `--pod-selector='app!=kv-seeder'` so seeder jobs stay.
Alex: good call.
Dan: Ops action: please post a public status at start, and mark as 'minor degradation' if P99 > 200ms beyond baseline.
Alex: Will do. I’ll push the playbook to runbook and ping #customer-notice at T-15.
Priya: Can PMs get a quick summary for release notes? one-liner and customer impact.
Alex: One-liner: "Planned rolling GPU reboot in az24; brief latency spikes possible; no data loss; most tenants unaffected." I'll DM PMs.
Lina: I'll start KV cache seed at 01:30 UTC and report back metrics.
ops-bot: mnt-az24-20260330 status: canary green. canary_nodes: 3, verification: ok.
Alex: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene T-10 in this thread for go/no-go.
